# judgekeeper

> Check your LLM-as-a-judge in 5 steps: Find. Mark. Measure. Fix. Re-check. An LLM-as-a-judge is an AI model that grades the answers of another AI model, Pass or Fail, with a rule. judgekeeper shows how often it agrees with you. It is an open-source command-line tool that runs on your own computer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.judgekeeper.com/): what judgekeeper is, a demo of the marking page, and what each of the 5 steps prints in the terminal.
- [Guide](https://www.judgekeeper.com/start.html): install (`pip install judgekeeper`, or `uvx judgekeeper` with uv), the 5 steps, why no API key is needed, your own CSV, TSV or JSONL file or `judgekeeper.record()`, and handy commands.
- [Try step 1 in your browser](https://www.judgekeeper.com/check.html): drop a results file from promptfoo or DeepEval, or your own CSV, TSV or JSONL file, and see judgekeeper's first step on it. The file is read in the page and never sent anywhere.
- [Privacy](https://www.judgekeeper.com/privacy.html): what this website and judgekeeper do with your data.

## More

- [Reference](https://github.com/judgekeeper/judgekeeper/blob/main/docs/reference.md): every command, flag, file and exit code.
- [Source code](https://github.com/judgekeeper/judgekeeper): the code, the changelog and the reports of every run on public data.
